title: Dropshipping profit calculator
metaDescription: Free dropshipping profit calculator — estimate profit, margin, fees, and break-even price per order for ecommerce stores.
intro: See what you actually keep after product cost, shipping, ads, and platform fees. Useful before you launch or scale a dropshipping offer.
description: Enter selling price, supplier cost, shipping, ad spend per order, and platform fee percent. We’ll show profit, margin, and a break-even price.
imageAlt: Free online dropshipping profit calculator for margin, fees, and break-even price
registryDescription: Estimate dropshipping profit and margin after product cost, shipping, ads, and platform fees.

title: AliExpress / supplier profit calculator
metaDescription: Free AliExpress supplier profit calculator — estimate landed cost, duties, fees, and profit for imported ecommerce products.
intro: Roll supplier cost, shipping, and duty into a true landed cost so you know if an AliExpress product can still make money.
description: Enter supplier price, shipping, customs duty, payment fees, and ads. We’ll estimate landed cost, total cost, profit, and margin.
imageAlt: Free online AliExpress supplier profit calculator for landed cost and margin
registryDescription: Estimate AliExpress and supplier landed cost, duties, fees, and profit per unit.

title: ROAS calculator
metaDescription: Free ROAS calculator — measure return on ad spend, contribution profit, and break-even ROAS for ecommerce ads.
intro: Check whether your ad spend is returning enough revenue — and what ROAS you need just to break even on margin.
description: Enter ad spend, attributed revenue, and gross margin. We’ll calculate ROAS, contribution profit, and break-even ROAS.
imageAlt: Free online ROAS calculator for ecommerce return on ad spend and break-even ROAS
registryDescription: Calculate return on ad spend, contribution profit, and break-even ROAS for paid campaigns.

title: Shopify fee calculator
metaDescription: Free Shopify fee calculator — estimate payment processing fees, plan fees, and net per order for Shopify stores.
intro: Estimate what Shopify-style plan and card fees take from each order and across a month of sales.
description: Enter average order value, monthly orders, plan fee, and card rate. We’ll show fees per order, monthly totals, and net.
imageAlt: Free online Shopify fee calculator for payment fees, plan fees, and net payout
registryDescription: Estimate Shopify plan and payment processing fees, monthly totals, and net per order.

title: PayPal / Stripe fee calculator
metaDescription: Free PayPal and Stripe fee calculator — estimate processing fees and net payout for domestic or international payments.
intro: Compare roughly what PayPal or Stripe takes from a payment so you can price with fees in mind.
description: Choose PayPal or Stripe, set amount and domestic/international, then see estimated fee and net amount.
imageAlt: Free online PayPal and Stripe fee calculator for processing fees and net payout
registryDescription: Estimate PayPal or Stripe processing fees and net payout for domestic or international charges.

title: Facebook ads budget calculator
metaDescription: Free Facebook ads budget calculator — project clicks, orders, CPA, ROAS, and revenue from daily Meta ad spend.
intro: Turn a daily Meta ads budget into expected clicks, orders, CPA, and ROAS before you spend.
description: Enter daily budget, campaign days, CPC, conversion rate, and AOV. We’ll project traffic, sales, and return.
imageAlt: Free online Facebook ads budget calculator for Meta CPC, CPA, ROAS, and revenue
registryDescription: Project Facebook/Meta ad clicks, orders, CPA, ROAS, and revenue from a daily budget.

title: Winning product score calculator
metaDescription: Free winning product score calculator — score dropshipping and ecommerce product ideas on demand, competition, margin, and trend.
intro: Score a product idea across demand, competition, margin, trend, and shipping ease before you invest in ads or inventory.
description: Rate each factor from 1–10 (and enter margin %). We’ll produce a 0–100 score with a clear grade and breakdown.
imageAlt: Free online winning product score calculator for dropshipping and ecommerce ideas
registryDescription: Score ecommerce product ideas on demand, competition, margin, trend, and shipping ease.

title: Discount impact calculator

imageAlt: Free online discount impact calculator for margin loss and break-even volume
registryDescription: Measure how a discount changes margin and how many extra units you need for the same profit.

title: CPA / ad cost calculator

imageAlt: Free online CPA ad cost calculator for cost per acquisition and max profitable CPA
registryDescription: Calculate cost per acquisition and the maximum profitable CPA from AOV and margin.

title: Conversion rate calculator

registryDescription: Calculate conversion rate and how many visitors you need to hit a sales goal.
